title: Jim Jordan discusses Trump's bill and censorship concerns
text:
U.S. Rep. Jim Jordan Representing Ohio's 4th District | Official U.S. House headshot
U.S. Rep. Jim Jordan Representing Ohio's 4th District | Official U.S. House headshot
Jim Jordan, a U.S. Congressman representing Ohio's 4th district since 2007, shared his thoughts on various topics through a series of tweets on July 9, 2025. The congressman has been an active political figure since replacing Mike Oxley in Congress and previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives and the Ohio Senate.
In a tweet posted at 00:03 UTC on July 9, Jim Jordan praised President Trump's legislative initiative, referring to it as "One Big Beautiful Bill." According to Jordan, this bill provides several benefits for Ohio families including "more of their hard-earned dollars," "school choice," and "no tax on overtime and tips."
Later that day, at 00:30 UTC, Jordan shared a tweet containing only a link. No further context was provided by the congressman in this post.
At 01:15 UTC on July 9, Jim Jordan tweeted about a roundtable discussion hosted by Breitbart News. In his tweet titled “Breitbart Fight Club Roundtable — @JudiciaryGOP”, he highlighted Republicans' eagerness to stop what he described as a censorship regime after Breitbart News was targeted for "saying the truth."
Jordan, who is currently living in Urbana and was born in Troy, Ohio in 1964, holds degrees from the University of Wisconsin–Madison and Capital University. He continues to be an influential voice within his party.
